usage: Restaurant owner requested reuse of WoW Thai public media for the website. Editorial gallery only; no menu-product association or claim of present availability.
processing: Preserve source content; apply EXIF orientation, resize whole image without upscaling, encode WebP quality82. Display crops use CSS object-fit; the Facebook poster letterbox bands are outside its4:5 visible frame. No generative edits.

video.access_evidence: Verified playing in a logged-out public Facebook browser page; downloaded with the supported video-element downloadMedia action. Ordinary public HTML had exposed only the poster; direct browser inspection resolved that limitation.
video.processing: ffmpeg -map 0:v:0 -an -c:v libx264 -preset medium -crf25 -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart -map_metadata -1; preserve the complete frame and sequence.
video.presentation: Native controls, playsinline, muted, preload=none, local poster; no autoplay/loop or social embed. Pause when offscreen/hidden.

excluded: Pre-relocation2021 interior photos and a STA interior with unverified original publisher were not used.
